name: role-matrix-tool_operator
objective: Role-matrix recette for tool_operator: the role is submitted against ALL 148 catalogued actions, asserting its role-specific verdict. In-scope (mcp): 0 allow, 2 escalate, 0 deny. Out-of-mandate: 146 deny (capability_overreach). Proves the engine never grants a silent allow to a role on an action it does not own.
teaching: A role's authority is bounded by the catalog, not by the action's existence: tool_operator is allowed only its low-risk routine actions, escalates the sensitive ones it is privileged for, and every other action -- in any other domain -- is denied by default. The full sweep is deterministic and replayable for audit (I4).

agents.system_prompt: You are the tool_operator agent. Your mandate covers mcp system(s).
